title: Connect with a Verified Advocate
intro: Request a formal review of {{name}} by a human lawyer. A verified advocate registered with the Bar Council of India will review your document.
placeholder: e.g. Please check if the 90-day notice period is legally enforceable under the Rent Control Act...
privacy: Your private document will be encrypted and shared only with the assigned advocate, and only with your clear permission.
successBody: An advocate from our partner panel will contact you within 24 business hours.

disclaimer.title: Important Legal & Regulatory Disclaimer
disclaimer.body: SmartLegal AI gives automated information and document analysis based on Indian laws. It is not formal legal representation, legal advice, or an advocate-client relationship under the Advocates Act, 1961. For serious disputes or court cases, please consult a qualified advocate registered with the Bar Council of India.
